# Vobet Media

> Growth agency for businesses (roofing, landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling, solar, car detailing, pressure washing, pest control, cleaning). Meta and Google campaigns, custom qualifying forms, and automated follow-up that turns enquiries into booked estimates. Guarantee: 120 qualified estimates in 90 days, or we keep working free until you get them.

Site: https://vobetmedia.com/ · Contact: hello@vobetmedia.com

## Key facts
- Industries served: roofing, landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling, windows, solar, concrete, fencing, painting, car detailing, pressure washing, pest control, cleaning services, pool care.
- Works only with businesses; ads run in the client's own Meta/Google accounts.
- Every enquiry is contacted in under 5 minutes during active hours; quotes are followed up automatically.
- Published results come from real Meta Ads Manager screenshots, not summaries.
- Landscaping (Texas): 52 leads at ~$17 each on $877 of spend, 15 jobs closed, 29% lead-to-close.
- Roofing (US): 74 leads, 33 inspections booked, $19.28 cost per lead, over two months.

## Articles
- [How a Vobet Media Campaign Gets Built, Step by Step](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/how-a-vobet-media-campaign-gets-built.html): A Vobet Media campaign has four parts: an audit of your offer and service area, Meta and Google ads that run in your own accounts, a custom qualifying form in place of instant forms, and an automated follow-up system that replies in minutes. Each part exists to turn a click into a booked, qualified estimate.
- [Meta Ads for Car Detailers: How to Fill Your Calendar With Better Jobs](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/meta-ads-for-car-detailers.html): Car detailers can use Meta ads to book higher-value work — ceramic coating, paint correction and full details — by leading with a specific offer, using a qualifying form to filter bargain hunters, and replying to enquiries fast. Vobet Media builds that system for car detailing and auto care businesses.
- [Why We Run Your Ads in Your Own Ad Account](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/why-we-run-ads-in-your-own-ad-account.html): Vobet Media runs every campaign inside the client's own Meta and Google ad accounts. The business owns the data, audiences and history, can see spend in real time, and keeps everything if the engagement ends. Ad budget stays in the client's account; the agency charges a separate management fee.
- [What the 90-Day Guarantee Actually Covers (and What It Doesn't)](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/what-the-90-day-guarantee-covers.html): The Vobet Media guarantee is 120 qualified estimates within 90 days, or we keep working at no charge until you get them. It covers booked, qualified estimates — the part we control — not whether a customer signs the contract afterwards. The full conditions are set out in the terms.
- [How the Vobet Media Follow-Up System Turns Enquiries Into Booked Jobs](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/how-our-follow-up-system-works.html): The Vobet Media follow-up system replies to new enquiries within minutes, books estimates where it can, and keeps chasing quotes that have gone quiet. It exists because the speed of the first reply and the discipline of the follow-up decide a large share of whether a lead becomes a booked job.
- [Why Vobet Media Only Works With Businesses](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/why-we-only-work-with-contractors.html): Vobet Media only works with businesses — roofers, landscapers, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling, solar, car detailers, pressure washers, pest control and cleaning crews — because one kind of client lets us build one system that we can guarantee: ads, a qualifying form, and follow-up that turns enquiries into booked estimates.
- [The Vobet Media Story](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/the-vobet-media-story.html): Vobet Media was built to own the part of lead generation most vendors ignore — the speed of the first reply and the follow-up after the quote. Ads run in the client's own account, results are published as real ad-account screenshots, and the guarantee is 120 qualified estimates in 90 days or we work free.
- ["The Leads Were Junk" Is Almost Never About the Leads](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/cheap-leads-are-costing-you-jobs.html): When a business says "the leads were junk", the cause is almost always one of three things: an instant form that collected anyone curious, a reply that came hours late, or a quote that was sent once and never chased. Fix those and the same traffic source starts producing booked jobs — on our landscaping account, 52 leads became 15 closed jobs.
- [Pay-Per-Lead vs. Pay-Per-Booked-Job: What Businesses Actually Pay For](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/pay-per-lead-vs-pay-per-booked-job.html): Pay-per-lead prices only the first step of a job. To compare offers, divide the lead price by the share that book and the share that close: a $25 lead at 10% booked and 30% closed costs $833 per job, while a $17 qualified lead at 29% lead-to-close costs about $58 per job. Ask whether leads are exclusive, what counts as billable, and whether the ad account is yours.
- [How to Qualify Pay-Per-Lead Enquiries Before You Drive Out](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/how-to-qualify-pay-per-lead-enquiries.html): Most "bad" pay-per-lead enquiries are unqualified rather than fake. Three form questions — what is the job, when do you want it done, and are you the owner — plus a first reply within five minutes remove most of the enquiries that were never going to become work, before a truck rolls.
- [Why Businesses Should Own Their Lead Engine Instead of Renting One](https://vobetmedia.com/blog/building-your-own-pay-per-lead-engine.html): Buying leads from a marketplace stops the moment you stop paying and leaves nothing behind. Running the same ads in your own Meta and Google accounts builds account history, audience data and brand — assets you keep — and cost per lead trends down as the account learns instead of staying flat at the marketplace price.

## Answers to common questions
- **What does Vobet Media do?** Builds and runs Meta and Google ad campaigns, custom qualifying forms, and automated follow-up for businesses, so enquiries become booked estimates.
- **Who is it for?** Businesses only — roofing, landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling, windows, solar, concrete, fencing, painting, car detailing, pressure washing, pest control, cleaning services, pool care and more.
- **What is the guarantee?** 120 qualified estimates in 90 days, or Vobet Media keeps working free until the client gets them.
- **What does it cost?** A monthly management fee plus ad budget; the budget stays in the client's own ad account. The figure is set on the first call.
- **How fast are leads contacted?** Under five minutes during active hours.
- **Who owns the ad account?** The client. Campaigns run in their own Meta and Google accounts, so the account history and audience data stay with them.
- **How long until results?** The build takes about two weeks; campaigns usually go live in week two or three and first enquiries land within days of launch.
- **Are results verifiable?** Yes — case studies publish the actual Meta Ads Manager screenshots, not summaries.
